label: Carina
interpretation: Experimental relative display-emission fit to registered optical and near-infrared outreach images on an evidence-linked authored single height surface. Observed sky anchors and published local topology motivate deformations; all depth, curvature and thickness remain authored and the wide background is unconstrained. No velocities, extinction or gas-density measurements are fitted. This solver cannot represent overlapping shells or foreground absorption. Shared geometry and conditional compact lights remain identical across image lenses.
